question: Do publicly reported numeric ADC, case/donor conditions and pathological identity permit a useful new measured account of benign-versus-malignant diffusion-threshold overlap/error in native EMC compared with fixed myxoidMLPS/MFS/LGFMS, beyond published same contrasts and known myxoid highT2/ADC exceptions?
before_values: No new eligible case ADC values inspected. Initial methods/source/prior-art gate only; exact externally established threshold, acquisition definition, comparator/statistic/uncertainty/defeater freeze required before case values. Previously verified imaging/FDG/FAPI/RT findings reused only at their original scope.
initial_sources: Primary broader myxoid/sarcoma diffusion studies found by disease/ADC/DWI aliases and citation trails
eligibility: Actual author-labelled extraskeletal myxoid chondrosarcoma identity retained with pathological/molecular confidence stated. Generic myxoid/chondrosarcoma unresolved, not silently EMC. Every eligible native EMC donor/specimen/condition retained, including untreated/treated/primary/metastatic/recurrence and unfavorable/zero/missing observations. Published case numeric tables preferred; no aggregate reconstruction or numerical values from authors' images.
measurement_gate: Numeric ADC with units, b-values/sequence/scanner and ROI summary/area/method, donor/lesion/condition/pathology linkage and appropriate same-protocol myxoid comparator. Technical ROIs/repeated lesions are not donors. Restricted/request-only raw measurements remain unavailable; suitable accessible source analysis remains pending and blocks promotion.
use: A robust new overlap/error observation could justify validation of morphology-aware acquisition/measurement interpretation in an independent study. Tiny descriptive overlap cannot establish a clinical diagnostic recommendation, tumor cellularity cause, safety, efficacy or biomarker utility.
strongest_alternatives: Primary studies already explicitly document these diffusion-threshold exceptions/overlaps
High water/myxoid extracellular matrix rather than a distinct useful EMC discriminator
b-value/ROI/sequence/scanner differences, necrosis/hemorrhage and treatment confound cross-source values
Referral/case selection and small donor number, tumorgrade/site/size or historical donor overlap
defeat: No individual suitable numeric ADC/donor-condition link or no comparable protocols; only image examples/aggregate highT2 descriptions; prior art already answers same question; no worthwhile independent replicated contribution; unresolved suitable public EMC observations. These defeat the current stage, not ADC biology or clinical efficacy.
pilot: Initial25minute source/prior-art gate; if appropriate new numeric data/question survives, send finite source manifest/staged plan to lead and prospectively freeze before numerical analysis. Do not manufacture a stage merely because a number is public.
